repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-llm
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin that manages LLM data-channel connections for meetings. It registers webex.internal.llm, a Mercury subclass that registers each session with the data-channel service over HTTP, connects the returned WebSocket through Mercury, and keeps per-session URLs, binding, owner meeting, and token-refresh handler, plus a session-keyed data-channel token cache guarded by owner-meeting checks.

llm-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.ts. Importing the package registers LLMChannel as internal plugin 'llm' with the config object from src/llm.ts. The barrel exports LLMChannel as default, DataChannelTokenType, LLM_DEFAULT_SESSION, LLM_PRACTICE_SESSION, and the RegisterAndConnectTiming type. Per-method behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

llm-plugin-events.summary: Events triggered on webex.internal.llm. LLMChannel inherits event emission from Mercury and sets the default session id to llm-default-session, so default-session events keep plain names (online, offline, event, event:<namespace>, event:<eventType>) and other sessions add a :<sessionId> suffix.

llm-datachannel-protocol.summary: Registration POST to the caller-supplied data-channel URL with body deviceUrl and, behind the data-channel-with-jwt-token toggle, the Data-Channel-Auth-Token header; response fields webSocketUrl and binding; and the subscriptionAwareSubchannels query added to the WebSocket URL behind the same toggle.

mercury-plugin-base.summary: Superclass of LLMChannel. Supplies connect, disconnect, disconnectAll, getSocket, session-suffixed event emission, retries, keepalive config consumption, and close-code handling. Owned by @webex/internal-plugin-mercury.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerInternalPlugin installs the plugin; the plugin base supplies this.request for the registration POST, this.logger, and this.config resolved from webex.config.llm.

webex-device-registration.summary: LLMChannel sends webex.internal.device.url as deviceUrl in the registration body. Mercury connect also registers the device when needed.

webex-feature-toggles.summary: LLMChannel calls getFeature('developer', 'data-channel-with-jwt-token') before registration and again before connect.
